name: p820-len-dynamic
code:
d = {"a":1}
keys = d.keys()
values = d.values()
items = d.items()
print(len(keys), len(values), len(items))

print(len(keys), len(values), len(items))
del d["a"]

name: p820-for-dynamic
code:
d = {"a":1, "b":2}
keys = d.keys()
values = d.values()
items = d.items()
d["c"] = 3
ka = []
va = []
ia = []
for x in keys:
    ka.append(x)
for x in values:
    va.append(x)
for x in items:
    ia.append(x)
print(ka, va, ia)
